newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks gets boost from economic data.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks gets boost from economic data.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite Index rose Thursday, boosted by economic data suggesting inflation remained steady last month.

The Nasdaq Composite Index gained 5.85 points or 0.44 percent to 1326.20. The Dow gained surged 76 points to close unofficially at 6626, a record high. In late trading, the long bond gained 1-4/32 to yield 6.75 percent.
Traders said stocks got a boost from the December producer price index, which indicated that wholesale prices rose 0.5 percent last month.
"The bonds rebounded after the PPI, which helped the (stock) market. Plus, there was some upswing after yesterday's drop," one trader said.
Technology stocks were mixed. Dell Computer Corp gained one to 57-3/8 after Prudential Securities raised its rating on the stock. Oracle Corp lost 1-5/8 to 41-3/4. Microsoft Corp shed one to 82-3/8.
PriceCostco Inc, a warehouse retailer, gained 1-1/8 to 26-5/8 after posting higher December sales. Staples Inc also jumped 1-5/8 to 20-1/8.
Gainers beat losers 2459 to 1904 on total volume of 636 million shares.
